title: proto: add faster deregister for header fields
description:
proto_deregister_field searches all fields of a parent to remove a
field. When removing a lot of dynamically registered fields, this is
very slow.

This patch adds a possibility to remove many fields in linear time.

This tremendously speeds up the removal of dynamically registered
fields with high numbers (e.g., 150k fields registered).

Signal PDU and SOME/IP are examples that profit from this change.

notes.body: With large configs, this patch speeds up changing profiles significantly as deregistering hfs is much slower than registering hfs. For some examples the time went from about 10s down to 1s.

I was looking at this problem some months ago, and I swear I remembered opening an issue proposing exactly the same approach, but I didn't.

On another note, I see that this MR changes the prefix of the fields from `signal_pdu` to `signal_pdu.signals`. This can potentially disrupt existing workflows. Is it necessary?

I prepared that code more than a year ago. Maybe you saw it before?

Yes, this is necessary because you must not deregister other fields. So you need a clean prefix.
P.S. Changing the prefix does also fix a problem that you could by accident overwrite an existing filter, which could lead to crashing Wireshark. Also for SOME/IP.

I was suggesting freeing it outside the loop, not completely remove it :sweat_smile: You might have an issue with no freeing if `last_field_name` is pointing to a field you just freed.

Got you :sweat_smile:.

I am not even sure it makes a difference.

Doesn't `proto_deregister_all_fields_with_prefix()` here deregister also the fields belonging to the other hf_register_infos?

Or am I missing something?

It is supposed to deregister all header fields of `proto_signal_pdu` that start with the `SPDU_NAME_SIGNAL_PREFIX`.

So it deregisters everything that was registered in packet-signal-pdu.c with this prefix. That is also the reason, why I had to move the signals to the prefix, so that no static header fields get deregistered.

I guess, we could optimize the code a bit by merging `deregister_user_data` and `deregister_user_data_hfarray`.

So that we call the `proto_deregister_all_fields_with_prefix` after we did the workaround for all.

Performance wise this does not matter as proto_deregister_all_fields_with_prefix will do nothing for the subsequent calls but this might make the code more robust, if we change something on the aggregation HFs later!?

Let me take a look.

The problem is that, when you call `deregister_user_data_hfarray(&dynamic_hf_base_raw, &dynamic_hf_base_raw_number)`, you set to NULL only the strings in `dynamic_hf_base_raw`, but you deregister (and then free) also the other fields.

Yes, merging the two was what I had in mind.

Actually, this is not a problem as it works or at least I could not make it fail during testing and I also just tested profiles with aggregations. 

But as this might stop working in the future, I created:
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19032
